run_slurm_pipeline: run a data processing pipeline on a SLURM cluster with configurable tasks, partition, and resource limits
launch_slurm_job: launch a SLURM job from a sbatch script and retrieve the job ID from the output
expand_slurm_nodelist: expand a SLURM nodelist with range notation into a list of individual hostnames
create_slurm_executor: create a SlurmPipelineExecutor to configure and launch distributed data processing tasks on a SLURM cluster
merge_pipeline_stats: launch a SLURM task to merge per-task stats into a single summary JSON file after pipeline completion
